label: Every composite has a cause, other than itself, of its being: things diverse in themselves come…
paraphrase: For every x satisfying the supplied Composite predicate, some c numerically different from x causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse). The bound Lean conclusion does not say that c unites components, is an efficient cause, is a nonpart, or is present/active at a selected world. The union derivation uses the separate OPEN uniter-to-esse premise fbee7f15; union alone is not sufficient. Aquinas ST I q.3 a.7 tertio motivates the proposed bridge but does not state this fully specified esse-cause conclusion without an interpretive step. Root consumers additionally require actual-world presence and causal correspondence.
